relevance_rank_note: AAIC 2023 conference abstract (Alzheimer's & Dementia 19(S13); not in PubMed, no full paper or preprint found) from the Yassine lab: the only source found that compares ABCA1 surface level and recycling-endosome localization in isogenic APOE4/4 vs APOE3/3 human iPSC astrocytes with endogenous APOE. Direction only: no values, P or n, and no figure panels, so every finding is class 3 and weak.

location: Abstract, Result section (no figure panels in a conference abstract)
description: Less ABCA1 was detected at the cell membrane in isogenic APOE4/4 than APOE3/3 human iPSC-derived astrocytes (membrane vs cytoplasmic ABCA1 by Western blot, per the Method section). The abstract gives no value, P or n.
quote: Consequently, less ABCA1 was detected at the cell membrane.
summary: (APOE3/3 -> APOE4/4, isogenic human iPSC astrocytes) -> (less plasma-membrane ABCA1)
human_check: The sentence does not restate the genotypes; they are taken from the two preceding Result sentences, which compare APOE4/4 with isogenic APOE3/3 astrocytes. Whether membrane ABCA1 was normalised to total is not stated, and total ABCA1 was also lower (separate row), so this may reflect less ABCA1 overall rather than a trafficking shift.

description: ABCA1 levels in Rab11+ recycling endosomes were lower in isogenic APOE4/4 than APOE3/3 human iPSC-derived astrocytes (image analysis). The abstract gives no value, P or n.
quote: Advanced image analysis revealed lower ABCA1 protein levels in Rab11+ recycling endosomes and less colocalization between ABCA1 and Rab7, a late endosome marker, in APOE4/4 astrocytes than APOE3/3 astrocytes.
summary: (APOE3/3 -> APOE4/4, isogenic human iPSC astrocytes) -> (less ABCA1 in Rab11+ recycling endosomes)
human_check: Coded not against, consistent with 38217595 Fig 8D and the 31641056 HeLa recycling-endosome row. A slow-loop block would predict more ABCA1 held in Rab11 endosomes, so this direction does not fit an ARF6-type recycling block; with total ABCA1 also lower, it may reflect less ABCA1 overall.
